I think she can spawn where any Drixie can, a tracker helped me find her, initially at -1096,-1379. Finally killed her at -1369, -2061. Likely don't have to kill Fairy Drixies because so many die by other mobs and she's only lvl 25.

Feb 2025: Spent a long time looking for her. Would routinely see her up on pet track near the outpost, but never saw her until I moved to about -1500, -1400. There are three drixie spawns in a little bowl that drolvargs patrol. I saw her three times in 30 minutes then, so I suspect these are the only spawns that work for her. Particularly near -1525, -1490.
